header: Standing discounts for four kinds of practice
subheader: Four fixed programmes, with nothing to negotiate.
lead: Send the listed proof to abrechnung@example.org, and the discount applies from your next invoice. If your situation changes mid-year, we do not reclaim it.
note: One discount per practice: we apply the largest you qualify for. Discounts apply to the plan price, not to usage charges or one-off fees.

programmes.title: New practice: 25% off for 12 months
programmes.text: For practices with a trade licence under 24 months old. Proof: your trade licence or the date of your first insurance fund contract.

programmes.title: Training practice: 15% off
programmes.text: For practices that host students on clinical placement for at least eight weeks a year. Proof: your placement agreement with the university.

programmes.title: Charitable provider: 20% off
programmes.text: For associations and foundations with charitable status. Proof: the current notice from the tax office.

programmes.title: Association member: 10% off
programmes.text: For members of a recognised professional body for physiotherapy, occupational therapy or speech therapy. Proof: your membership number.
